h1.en: Just Lost Your Job in Tennessee? Here Are Your 2026 Health Insurance Options
h1.es: Acaba de Perder Su Trabajo en Tennessee? Estas Son Sus Opciones de Seguro Medico 2026

subhero.en: You have 60 days from your last day of employer coverage to enroll in a new plan. Tennessee did not expand Medicaid, so most laid-off Tennessee workers use the ACA Marketplace at healthcare.gov or COBRA, not TennCare.
subhero.es: Tiene 60 dias desde su ultimo dia de cobertura del empleador para inscribirse en un nuevo plan. Tennessee no expandio Medicaid, por lo que la mayoria usa el Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov o COBRA, no TennCare.

heading.en: You have 60 days from your Tennessee coverage loss date
heading.es: Tiene 60 dias desde la fecha de perdida de cobertura en Tennessee

body.en: Your 60-day loss-of-coverage Special Enrollment Period starts the day after your employer coverage ends in Tennessee. For example, if your last day of coverage is June 30, 2026, your SEP window runs July 1 through August 29, 2026. Miss that window and you typically wait until the next ACA Open Enrollment Period starting November 1, 2026, for 2027 coverage. TennCare (Tennessee Medicaid) does not cover most laid-off adults, so the Marketplace SEP is your primary path.
body.es: Su Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias comienza el dia despues de que termina su cobertura del empleador en Tennessee. Por ejemplo, si su ultimo dia de cobertura es el 30 de junio de 2026, su ventana SEP corre del 1 de julio al 29 de agosto de 2026. Si pierde esa ventana, tipicamente espera hasta la proxima Inscripcion Abierta del ACA que comienza el 1 de noviembre de 2026. TennCare no cubre a la mayoria de adultos despedidos.

quickAnswer.en: Losing job-based health insurance in Tennessee triggers a 60-day Special Enrollment Period (SEP). Tennessee is a non-expansion state, so TennCare (Tennessee Medicaid) covers very few laid-off adults. Your three realistic options are: (1) ACA Marketplace plan through healthcare.gov with income-based premium tax credits, typically $10 to $300 per month after credits in 2026 for incomes between 100% and 400% FPL; (2) COBRA continuation at 102% of the full premium, often $500 to $2,800 per month; or (3) a spouse's employer plan if you are married and your spouse has job-based coverage. Most Tennessee workers who lose a job qualify for substantial Marketplace subsidies and pay far less than COBRA. Apply at healthcare.gov within 60 days of your last day of employer coverage.
quickAnswer.es: Perder el seguro medico del trabajo en Tennessee activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial (SEP) de 60 dias. Tennessee es un estado sin expansion, por lo que TennCare (Medicaid de Tennessee) cubre muy pocos adultos despedidos. Sus tres opciones realistas son: (1) plan del Mercado ACA a traves de healthcare.gov con creditos fiscales de prima basados en ingresos, tipicamente $10 a $300 al mes en 2026 para ingresos entre 100% y 400% FPL; (2) continuacion COBRA al 102% de la prima completa, a menudo $500 a $2,800 al mes; o (3) el plan del empleador de su conyuge si esta casado. La mayoria de trabajadores de Tennessee que pierden un trabajo califican para subsidios sustanciales del Mercado y pagan mucho menos que COBRA. Solicite en healthcare.gov dentro de los 60 dias.

introParagraphs.en: Losing a job in Tennessee is stressful enough without a health coverage crisis on top of it. The federal health system built a specific safety valve for this exact moment: the loss-of-coverage Special Enrollment Period (SEP). Under federal HIPAA Section 9831 rules, any involuntary loss of minimum essential coverage from an employer-sponsored plan is a qualifying life event (QLE) that opens a 60-day enrollment window. That window is the same whether you were laid off, furloughed, or your employer closed. Tennessee workers face one critical reality that residents of 40 other states do not: Tennessee did not expand Medicaid under the ACA, so TennCare (Tennessee's Medicaid program) covers only very narrow categories of adults, primarily pregnant women, children, parents of minors with very low income, and people with qualifying disabilities. Most laid-off Tennessee adults who would have qualified for Medicaid in an expansion state fall into a coverage gap in Tennessee. The ACA Marketplace at healthcare.gov is the primary path. The 2026 ACA Marketplace Open Enrollment Period ended January 15, 2026. Without a SEP triggered by your job loss, you have no path to subsidized Marketplace coverage until the 2027 OEP opens November 1, 2026. Acting within 60 days is not optional.
introParagraphs.es: Perder un trabajo en Tennessee es suficientemente estresante sin agregar una crisis de cobertura medica. El sistema de salud federal construyo una valvula de seguridad especifica para este momento exacto: el Periodo de Inscripcion Especial (SEP) por perdida de cobertura. Bajo las reglas federales de la Seccion 9831 de HIPAA, cualquier perdida involuntaria de cobertura minima esencial de un plan patrocinado por el empleador es un evento calificador de vida (QLE) que abre una ventana de inscripcion de 60 dias. Tennessee no expandio Medicaid bajo el ACA, por lo que TennCare (el programa Medicaid de Tennessee) cubre solo categorias muy limitadas de adultos, principalmente mujeres embarazadas, ninos, padres de menores con ingresos muy bajos, y personas con discapacidades calificadas. La mayoria de adultos de Tennessee que pierden el trabajo no califican para TennCare. El Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov es el camino principal. El Periodo de Inscripcion Abierta del ACA 2026 termino el 15 de enero de 2026. Sin un SEP activado por la perdida de trabajo, no tiene acceso a cobertura subsidiada hasta que la OEP 2027 abra el 1 de noviembre de 2026. Actuar dentro de los 60 dias no es opcional.

introParagraphs.en: Tennessee's non-expansion status creates a coverage gap that affects workers who earn too little for ACA subsidies but too much for TennCare. Specifically, adults with income below 100% of the Federal Poverty Level ($15,960 for a single person in 2026) do not qualify for Marketplace premium tax credits (which start at 100% FPL) and typically do not qualify for TennCare unless they meet a categorical eligibility requirement. If you project your 2026 household income above 100% FPL, the ACA Marketplace is your primary option, with premium tax credits potentially reducing your monthly premium significantly. If you project income below 100% FPL without a TennCare categorical eligibility, you are in the coverage gap where neither program is immediately available. In that scenario, enrolling in a $0-cost-sharing Bronze plan via healthcare.gov (available to those below 100% FPL who would qualify for Medicaid in an expansion state) may be possible under certain hardship SEP rules. The quickest first step in Tennessee is always to confirm your projected income for the rest of 2026, then apply simultaneously at healthcare.gov and check TennCare eligibility at tennessee.gov/tenncare.
introParagraphs.es: El estado de no expansion de Tennessee crea una brecha de cobertura que afecta a trabajadores que ganan demasiado poco para los subsidios ACA pero demasiado para TennCare. Especificamente, los adultos con ingresos por debajo del 100% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza ($15,960 para una persona en 2026) no califican para los creditos fiscales de prima del Mercado (que comienzan al 100% FPL) y tipicamente no califican para TennCare a menos que cumplan un requisito de elegibilidad categorico. Si proyecta su ingreso del hogar para 2026 por encima del 100% FPL, el Mercado ACA es su opcion principal, con creditos fiscales de prima que potencialmente reducen su prima mensual significativamente. Si proyecta ingresos por debajo del 100% FPL sin elegibilidad categorica de TennCare, esta en la brecha de cobertura. El primer paso mas rapido en Tennessee es siempre confirmar su ingreso proyectado para el resto de 2026, luego solicitar simultaneamente en healthcare.gov y verificar la elegibilidad de TennCare en tennessee.gov/tenncare.

name.en: Confirm your last day of Tennessee employer coverage
name.es: Confirme su ultimo dia de cobertura del empleador en Tennessee

text.en: Call your HR department or check your termination letter to get the exact date your employer coverage ends in Tennessee. Most employer plans end on the last day of the month you were terminated, but some end on your actual termination date. This date starts your 60-day SEP clock. Request a HIPAA certificate of creditable coverage in writing from your former employer, as healthcare.gov requires this as proof of your qualifying life event when you submit your Marketplace SEP application.
text.es: Llame a su departamento de recursos humanos o revise su carta de terminacion para obtener la fecha exacta en que termina su cobertura del empleador en Tennessee. La mayoria de planes del empleador terminan el ultimo dia del mes en que fue despedido, pero algunos terminan en la fecha real de terminacion. Esta fecha inicia su reloj SEP de 60 dias. Solicite por escrito un certificado de cobertura acreditable de HIPAA a su antiguo empleador, ya que healthcare.gov lo requiere como prueba de su evento calificador de vida.

name.en: Calculate your projected 2026 household income for Tennessee
name.es: Calcule su ingreso proyectado del hogar para Tennessee 2026

text.en: Use only what you expect to earn for the rest of 2026, not your previous annual salary. Include unemployment compensation in your projection (Tennessee unemployment benefits count as Modified Adjusted Gross Income under IRS MAGI rules). If you have a spouse or other household members with income, include those amounts. For Tennessee, if your projected income falls below 100% FPL ($15,960 single, $33,000 family of four in 2026), you are in the coverage gap because Tennessee did not expand TennCare. If your projected income is between 100% and 400% FPL, ACA Marketplace premium tax credits at healthcare.gov apply and can dramatically reduce your monthly premium.
text.es: Use solo lo que espera ganar el resto de 2026, no su salario anual anterior. Incluya la compensacion por desempleo en su proyeccion (los beneficios de desempleo de Tennessee cuentan como Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado bajo las reglas MAGI del IRS). Si tiene un conyuge u otros miembros del hogar con ingresos, incluya esas cantidades. Para Tennessee, si su ingreso proyectado cae por debajo del 100% FPL ($15,960 individual, $33,000 familia de cuatro en 2026), esta en la brecha de cobertura porque Tennessee no expandio TennCare. Si su ingreso proyectado esta entre 100% y 400% FPL, los creditos fiscales de prima del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov aplican.

name.es: Verifique la elegibilidad de TennCare en tennessee.gov/tenncare

text.en: TennCare covers pregnant women, children under 19, and parents or caretaker relatives of minors who meet strict income limits (typically under 95% FPL for parents). Most laid-off Tennessee adults without children or a qualifying disability do not qualify for TennCare under current Tennessee law. Check your eligibility at tennessee.gov/tenncare or call 1-800-342-3145 before ruling it out. If you do qualify for TennCare, enrollment is year-round with no 60-day deadline, and TennCare is free or near-free for those who qualify.
text.es: TennCare cubre a mujeres embarazadas, ninos menores de 19 anos, y padres o cuidadores de menores que cumplan limites estrictos de ingresos (tipicamente menos del 95% FPL para padres). La mayoria de adultos de Tennessee despedidos sin hijos o una discapacidad calificada no califican para TennCare bajo la ley actual. Verifique su elegibilidad en tennessee.gov/tenncare o llame al 1-800-342-3145 antes de descartarlo. Si califica para TennCare, la inscripcion es todo el ano sin fecha limite de 60 dias, y TennCare es gratuito o casi gratuito para quienes califican.

name.en: Apply for ACA Marketplace SEP at healthcare.gov within 60 days
name.es: Solicite el SEP del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov dentro de 60 dias

text.en: Log in to healthcare.gov and select 'Report a life event' then 'Lost health insurance through a job.' Tennessee uses the federal Marketplace at healthcare.gov (not a state exchange). Upload your termination letter or HIPAA certificate as documentation. Compare Silver and Gold plan options for your Tennessee ZIP code. In 2026, premium tax credits reduce most Silver plans to $10 to $300 per month for incomes between 100% and 400% FPL. Silver plans with cost-sharing reductions (CSR) are available if your income is between 100% and 250% FPL and offer reduced deductibles and copays beyond the standard premium reduction.
text.es: Inicie sesion en healthcare.gov y seleccione 'Reportar un evento de vida' luego 'Perdi el seguro medico a traves de un trabajo.' Tennessee usa el Mercado federal en healthcare.gov (no un intercambio estatal). Suba su carta de terminacion o certificado HIPAA como documentacion. Compare opciones de planes Silver y Gold para su codigo postal en Tennessee. En 2026, los creditos fiscales de prima reducen la mayoria de planes Silver a $10 a $300 al mes para ingresos entre 100% y 400% FPL. Los planes Silver con reducciones de costos compartidos (CSR) estan disponibles si su ingreso esta entre 100% y 250% FPL.

name.en: Check your spouse's employer plan (if married)
name.es: Verifique el plan del empleador de su conyuge (si esta casado)

text.en: Your Tennessee job loss is also a qualifying life event for your spouse's employer plan, giving you 30 days to enroll. Call your spouse's HR department immediately, because the 30-day employer-plan window is separate from and shorter than the 60-day Marketplace SEP. A spouse's employer plan is often the cheapest option when the employer subsidizes a significant portion of the premium, but compare the plan's provider network against your Tennessee doctors before committing.
text.es: La perdida de su trabajo en Tennessee es tambien un evento calificador de vida para el plan del empleador de su conyuge, dandole 30 dias para inscribirse. Llame inmediatamente al departamento de recursos humanos de su conyuge, porque la ventana del plan del empleador de 30 dias es separada y mas corta que el SEP del Mercado de 60 dias. El plan del empleador de un conyuge es a menudo la opcion mas barata cuando el empleador subsidia una parte significativa de la prima, pero compare la red de proveedores del plan con sus medicos en Tennessee antes de comprometerse.

name.en: Evaluate COBRA only after comparing all other Tennessee options
name.es: Evalue COBRA solo despues de comparar todas las otras opciones en Tennessee

text.en: COBRA charges 102% of the full group premium (employer share plus employee share plus a 2% administrative fee). For a Tennessee single person, that is typically $500 to $900 per month; for a Tennessee family, $1,200 to $2,800 per month in 2026. COBRA is worth considering only if you have ongoing treatment with a specialist not in any Tennessee Marketplace network, or if your deductible for 2026 is already substantially met. You have 60 days to elect COBRA and can elect it retroactively, so you do not have to decide immediately. Compare COBRA cost against Marketplace plans at healthcare.gov before deciding.
text.es: COBRA cobra el 102% de la prima grupal completa (parte del empleador mas la del empleado mas el 2% de tarifa administrativa). Para una persona en Tennessee, eso es tipicamente $500 a $900 al mes; para una familia de Tennessee, $1,200 a $2,800 al mes en 2026. COBRA vale la pena considerar solo si tiene tratamiento continuo con un especialista que no esta en ninguna red del Mercado de Tennessee, o si su deducible para 2026 ya esta sustancialmente cumplido. Tiene 60 dias para elegir COBRA y puede elegirlo retroactivamente. Compare el costo de COBRA con los planes del Mercado en healthcare.gov antes de decidir.

name.en: Check CHIP for your children at tennessee.gov/tenncare
name.es: Verifique CHIP para sus hijos en tennessee.gov/tenncare

text.en: Tennessee's CoverKids program (CHIP) provides low-cost health coverage for children up to age 19 in families with incomes up to approximately 250% FPL. CoverKids enrollment is year-round with no deadline. Even if you do not qualify for TennCare yourself after the job loss, your children may qualify for CoverKids at low or no cost. Apply at tennessee.gov/tenncare or through healthcare.gov. Children can also be enrolled in your new ACA Marketplace plan during the 60-day SEP.
text.es: El programa CoverKids de Tennessee (CHIP) proporciona cobertura de salud a bajo costo para ninos hasta 19 anos en familias con ingresos hasta aproximadamente 250% FPL. La inscripcion en CoverKids es todo el ano sin fecha limite. Incluso si usted no califica para TennCare despues de perder el trabajo, sus hijos pueden calificar para CoverKids a bajo costo o sin costo. Solicite en tennessee.gov/tenncare o a traves de healthcare.gov. Los ninos tambien pueden inscribirse en su nuevo plan del Mercado ACA durante el SEP de 60 dias.

intro.en: The costliest mistakes Tennessee workers make after losing job-based coverage in 2026:
intro.es: Los errores mas costosos que los trabajadores de Tennessee cometen despues de perder cobertura del trabajo en 2026:

items.en: Assuming TennCare will cover you after job loss. Tennessee did not expand Medicaid, so TennCare covers very few laid-off adults. Most Tennessee workers who lose their jobs must use the ACA Marketplace at healthcare.gov, not TennCare.
items.es: Asumir que TennCare lo cubrira despues de perder el trabajo. Tennessee no expandio Medicaid, por lo que TennCare cubre muy pocos adultos despedidos. La mayoria de trabajadores de Tennessee que pierden su trabajo deben usar el Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov, no TennCare.

items.en: Defaulting to COBRA without comparing Marketplace plans at healthcare.gov. COBRA is almost always the most expensive path. Most Tennessee job-loss situations involve an income drop that generates large premium tax credits, making Marketplace plans dramatically cheaper.
items.es: Optar automaticamente por COBRA sin comparar planes del Mercado en healthcare.gov. COBRA es casi siempre el camino mas caro. La mayoria de situaciones de perdida de trabajo en Tennessee implican una caida de ingresos que genera grandes creditos fiscales de prima, haciendo los planes del Mercado dramaticamente mas baratos.

items.en: Reporting your old annual salary instead of projected 2026 income. The Marketplace calculates subsidies on Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) for the rest of the current year, not your prior salary. A lower projection means a larger premium tax credit.
items.es: Reportar su salario anual anterior en lugar del ingreso proyectado de 2026. El Mercado calcula los subsidios sobre el Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) para el resto del ano actual, no su salario anterior. Una proyeccion mas baja significa un credito fiscal de prima mas grande.

items.en: Forgetting that Tennessee unemployment compensation counts as income for ACA subsidy calculations. Include your weekly unemployment benefit times the number of weeks you expect to receive it in your projected 2026 annual income when applying at healthcare.gov.
items.es: Olvidar que la compensacion por desempleo de Tennessee cuenta como ingreso para los calculos de subsidio ACA. Incluya su beneficio semanal de desempleo multiplicado por el numero de semanas que espera recibirlo en su ingreso anual proyectado de 2026 al solicitar en healthcare.gov.

items.en: Missing the 60-day SEP window. Without active SEP documentation, healthcare.gov will reject a Marketplace application submitted after Day 60. The next path is waiting for the 2027 ACA OEP starting November 1, 2026, creating a coverage gap.
items.es: Perder la ventana SEP de 60 dias. Sin documentacion SEP activa, healthcare.gov rechazara una solicitud del Mercado enviada despues del dia 60. El siguiente camino es esperar la OEP ACA 2027 que comienza el 1 de noviembre de 2026, creando una brecha de cobertura.

items.en: Not checking CoverKids for children separately. Tennessee's CoverKids (CHIP) covers children in households up to roughly 250% FPL, which is far above adult TennCare thresholds. Children may qualify for CoverKids even when parents do not qualify for TennCare.
items.es: No verificar CoverKids para los ninos por separado. CoverKids de Tennessee (CHIP) cubre ninos en hogares hasta aproximadamente 250% FPL, muy por encima de los umbrales de TennCare para adultos. Los ninos pueden calificar para CoverKids aunque los padres no califiquen para TennCare.

heading.en: COBRA vs ACA Marketplace vs Spouse's Plan: Which to Choose in Tennessee in 2026?
heading.es: COBRA vs Mercado ACA vs Plan del Conyuge: Cual Elegir en Tennessee en 2026?

body.en: After losing job-based coverage in Tennessee in 2026, three major pathways open. COBRA preserves your old plan at 102% of the full premium, typically $500 to $900 per month for a Tennessee individual and $1,200 to $2,800 per month for Tennessee family coverage, making it the most expensive option in almost every scenario. ACA Marketplace plans at healthcare.gov reduce most Tennessee enrollees to $10 to $300 per month after premium tax credits (per KFF 2026 Marketplace Premium Analysis), with the trade-off that you may need to change providers if your former employer's plan network differs from available Tennessee Marketplace networks. A spouse's employer plan costs the employee share of the group premium, often $100 to $600 per month, and is available when your spouse's Tennessee employer offers a 30-day qualifying-event SEP (most do under Section 9831 of HIPAA). The Tennessee decision framework: check TennCare first (free, year-round, only if you meet categorical eligibility as a parent, pregnant woman, or disability case); then check spouse's plan (if cheaper than Marketplace and network covers your Tennessee providers); then apply for ACA Marketplace SEP at healthcare.gov with premium tax credits (the most common 2026 path for most Tennessee laid-off workers); use COBRA only as a last resort when you have ongoing treatment with a Tennessee specialist not in any Marketplace network or have a substantially met deductible for the current plan year.
body.es: Despues de perder la cobertura del trabajo en Tennessee en 2026, tres caminos principales se abren. COBRA preserva su plan anterior al 102% de la prima completa, tipicamente $500 a $900 al mes para un individuo de Tennessee y $1,200 a $2,800 al mes para cobertura familiar de Tennessee, convirtiendolo en la opcion mas cara en casi todos los escenarios. Los planes del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov reducen a la mayoria de inscritos de Tennessee a $10 a $300 al mes despues de creditos fiscales de prima (segun el Analisis de Prima del Mercado KFF 2026). El plan del empleador de un conyuge cuesta la parte del empleado de la prima grupal, a menudo $100 a $600 al mes. El marco de decision de Tennessee: verificar TennCare primero (gratuito, todo el ano, solo si cumple elegibilidad categorica como padre, mujer embarazada o caso de discapacidad); luego verificar el plan del conyuge; luego solicitar el SEP del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov con creditos fiscales; usar COBRA solo como ultimo recurso.

stateRules.rule: TennCare (Tennessee Medicaid) did not expand under the ACA. Eligibility is limited to pregnant women, children under 19 (CoverKids / CHIP up to ~250% FPL), parents or caretaker relatives of minors under ~95% FPL, and people with qualifying disabilities or who are aged and blind. Most laid-off Tennessee adults without children or a qualifying disability do not qualify for TennCare. The Tennessee coverage gap affects adults with income between 0% and 100% FPL who do not meet TennCare categorical requirements. Apply at tennessee.gov/tenncare or call 1-800-342-3145.

Tennessee uses the federal Marketplace at healthcare.gov (not a state-based exchange). Tennessee residents apply for ACA Marketplace SEP plans directly at healthcare.gov. There is no separate Tennessee Marketplace portal.

Tennessee's CoverKids program provides CHIP coverage for children in families with incomes up to approximately 250% FPL. CoverKids enrollment is year-round with no deadline. Apply at tennessee.gov/tenncare. Children in Tennessee who are not eligible for TennCare (such as lawfully present immigrants with fewer than 5 years residency) may still qualify for CoverKids under state law.

heading.en: Tennessee's Coverage Gap: What Happens When TennCare Does Not Cover You
heading.es: La Brecha de Cobertura de Tennessee: Que Pasa Cuando TennCare No lo Cubre

paragraphs.en: Tennessee is one of 10 states that did not expand Medicaid under the Affordable Care Act. TennCare, Tennessee's Medicaid program, operates under strict categorical eligibility rules that exclude most non-disabled adults who do not have dependent children. A Tennessee worker who loses a job and projects income below 100% FPL ($15,960 for a single person in 2026) faces a genuine coverage gap: too little income to receive ACA premium tax credits (which start at 100% FPL) and typically not meeting TennCare's categorical requirements. This gap does not exist in the 40 expansion states plus DC, where Medicaid covers all adults at or below 138% FPL regardless of categorical status.
paragraphs.es: Tennessee es uno de los 10 estados que no expandio Medicaid bajo la Ley de Cuidado de Salud Asequible. TennCare, el programa Medicaid de Tennessee, opera bajo reglas estrictas de elegibilidad categorica que excluyen a la mayoria de adultos no discapacitados sin hijos dependientes. Un trabajador de Tennessee que pierde un trabajo y proyecta ingresos por debajo del 100% FPL ($15,960 para una persona en 2026) enfrenta una brecha de cobertura genuina: ingresos demasiado bajos para recibir creditos fiscales de prima del ACA (que comienzan al 100% FPL) y tipicamente sin cumplir los requisitos categoricos de TennCare. Esta brecha no existe en los 40 estados de expansion mas DC.

paragraphs.en: Tennessee workers who fall into the coverage gap have limited options. Short-term health plans are sold in Tennessee but are not ACA-compliant, do not cover pre-existing conditions, and carry significant limitations on benefits and lifetime caps. Community health centers (Federally Qualified Health Centers, FQHCs) operate on sliding-scale fees and provide primary care to uninsured Tennessee residents, but do not replace comprehensive health coverage. If your projected 2026 Tennessee income is between 0% and 100% FPL and you do not meet TennCare categorical requirements, check whether a family member's income would lift the household above 100% FPL, which would make you eligible for ACA Marketplace premium tax credits through healthcare.gov. Tennessee Legal Aid and navigator organizations can help identify whether any categorical TennCare pathway applies to your situation.
paragraphs.es: Los trabajadores de Tennessee que caen en la brecha de cobertura tienen opciones limitadas. Los planes de salud a corto plazo se venden en Tennessee pero no cumplen con el ACA, no cubren condiciones preexistentes y tienen limitaciones significativas. Los centros de salud comunitarios (FQHCs) operan con tarifas escalonadas y brindan atencion primaria a residentes de Tennessee sin seguro, pero no reemplazan la cobertura de salud integral. Si su ingreso proyectado de 2026 en Tennessee esta entre 0% y 100% FPL y no cumple los requisitos categoricos de TennCare, verifique si el ingreso de un miembro de la familia elevaria el hogar por encima del 100% FPL, lo que lo haria elegible para creditos fiscales de prima del Mercado ACA a traves de healthcare.gov.

heading.en: ACA Marketplace Plans in Tennessee After Job Loss: 2026 Costs and Networks
heading.es: Planes del Mercado ACA en Tennessee Despues de Perder el Trabajo: Costos y Redes 2026

paragraphs.en: Tennessee ACA Marketplace plans are administered through the federal healthcare.gov exchange. Major carriers offering Tennessee Marketplace plans in 2026 include BlueCross BlueShield of Tennessee, Cigna, and Oscar Health, though plan availability varies significantly by county. Tennessee's largest metro areas (Nashville, Memphis, Knoxville, Chattanooga) typically have more plan options than rural Tennessee counties. Before selecting a Marketplace plan during your 60-day SEP, verify that your current Tennessee doctors and hospitals are in-network for the specific plan you are considering, because networks differ substantially between carriers and between Silver and Gold plan tiers. For 2026, Silver plans with cost-sharing reductions (CSR) are available to Tennessee households with income between 100% and 250% FPL. CSR Silver plans reduce your deductible and out-of-pocket maximum significantly, offering better value than a standard Bronze plan for Tennessee workers who expect to use their coverage.
paragraphs.es: Los planes del Mercado ACA de Tennessee se administran a traves del intercambio federal healthcare.gov. Los principales aseguradoras que ofrecen planes del Mercado de Tennessee en 2026 incluyen BlueCross BlueShield de Tennessee, Cigna y Oscar Health, aunque la disponibilidad de planes varia significativamente por condado. Las principales areas metropolitanas de Tennessee (Nashville, Memphis, Knoxville, Chattanooga) tipicamente tienen mas opciones de planes que los condados rurales de Tennessee. Antes de seleccionar un plan del Mercado durante su SEP de 60 dias, verifique que sus medicos y hospitales actuales de Tennessee esten en la red del plan especifico que esta considerando. Para 2026, los planes Silver con reducciones de costos compartidos (CSR) estan disponibles para hogares de Tennessee con ingresos entre 100% y 250% FPL.

paragraphs.en: Premium tax credits in Tennessee for 2026 are calculated as a percentage of your projected annual Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) relative to the Federal Poverty Level. The 400% FPL subsidy cliff returned for plan year 2026 after enhanced premium tax credits from the American Rescue Plan Act expired January 1, 2026. Tennessee households above 400% FPL ($63,840 for a single person, $132,000 for a family of four in 2026) receive no premium tax credit. However, most Tennessee workers who lose a job experience an income drop that brings them well below the 400% FPL cliff, making large tax credits newly available. Use the healthcare.gov plan comparison tool to enter your specific Tennessee ZIP code and projected 2026 income to see actual premium tax credit amounts before making your plan selection during the 60-day SEP. After enrolling, you will receive Form 1095-A from healthcare.gov to reconcile your premium tax credits when you file your 2026 federal return.
paragraphs.es: Los creditos fiscales de prima en Tennessee para 2026 se calculan como un porcentaje de su Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) anual proyectado en relacion al Nivel Federal de Pobreza. El precipicio de subsidio del 400% FPL regreso para el ano del plan 2026 despues de que los creditos fiscales de prima mejorados de la Ley del Plan de Rescate Americano expiraron el 1 de enero de 2026. Los hogares de Tennessee por encima del 400% FPL ($63,840 para una persona, $132,000 para una familia de cuatro en 2026) no reciben credito fiscal de prima. Sin embargo, la mayoria de trabajadores de Tennessee que pierden un trabajo experimentan una caida de ingresos que los lleva bien por debajo del precipicio del 400% FPL. Use la herramienta de comparacion de planes de healthcare.gov para ver los montos reales de credito fiscal antes de seleccionar su plan durante el SEP de 60 dias. Despues de inscribirse, recibira el Formulario 1095-A de healthcare.gov para reconciliar sus creditos fiscales al presentar su declaracion federal de 2026.

heading.en: COBRA vs ACA Marketplace in Tennessee: A Cost Comparison for 2026
heading.es: COBRA vs Mercado ACA en Tennessee: Una Comparacion de Costos para 2026

paragraphs.en: COBRA allows Tennessee workers to continue their former employer's group health plan for up to 18 months (36 months for dependents in some scenarios) at 102% of the full premium. For employers with 20 or more employees, federal COBRA applies. Tennessee employers with fewer than 20 employees may offer state continuation coverage, but Tennessee does not have a mini-COBRA statute that universally extends continuation beyond federal COBRA eligibility, so smaller-employer options vary. The 2026 typical COBRA cost for a Tennessee individual is $500 to $900 per month; for a Tennessee family, $1,200 to $2,800 per month. COBRA makes financial sense only when you have ongoing care with a Tennessee specialist not available in any Marketplace network, or when you have already met a large deductible for the 2026 plan year. You have 60 days from your qualifying event to elect COBRA, and election is retroactive, meaning you can wait and decide whether you need the coverage before committing to the first month's premium.
paragraphs.es: COBRA permite a los trabajadores de Tennessee continuar el plan de salud grupal de su antiguo empleador hasta por 18 meses (36 meses para dependientes en algunos escenarios) al 102% de la prima completa. Para empleadores con 20 o mas empleados, aplica el COBRA federal. Los empleadores de Tennessee con menos de 20 empleados pueden ofrecer cobertura de continuacion estatal, pero Tennessee no tiene un estatuto mini-COBRA que extienda universalmente la continuacion mas alla de la elegibilidad federal de COBRA. El costo tipico de COBRA 2026 para un individuo de Tennessee es $500 a $900 al mes; para una familia de Tennessee, $1,200 a $2,800 al mes. COBRA tiene sentido financiero solo cuando tiene atencion continua con un especialista de Tennessee no disponible en ninguna red del Mercado, o cuando ya ha cumplido un gran deducible para el ano del plan 2026.

heading.en: Tennessee Unemployment Benefits and ACA Subsidy Eligibility in 2026
heading.es: Beneficios de Desempleo de Tennessee y Elegibilidad de Subsidio ACA en 2026

paragraphs.en: Tennessee unemployment compensation counts as income for ACA Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) calculations at healthcare.gov. Tennessee's maximum weekly unemployment benefit was $275 per week as of 2026, with a maximum duration of 26 weeks, though actual amounts vary based on prior wages. Including unemployment benefits in your projected 2026 income is required; failing to include it is one of the most common documentation errors on Tennessee Marketplace applications. As a practical example: a Tennessee worker laid off in June 2026 who receives $275 per week in unemployment for 20 weeks would add $5,500 to their projected income for the rest of 2026. This amount could push income above 100% FPL, qualifying the worker for ACA premium tax credits rather than leaving them in the coverage gap. The Marketplace system will ask you to project total 2026 household income; if that projection proves materially wrong, you reconcile at tax time using Form 1095-A.
paragraphs.es: La compensacion por desempleo de Tennessee cuenta como ingreso para los calculos del Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) del ACA en healthcare.gov. El beneficio semanal maximo de desempleo de Tennessee era $275 a la semana en 2026, con una duracion maxima de 26 semanas. Incluir los beneficios de desempleo en su ingreso proyectado de 2026 es obligatorio; no incluirlo es uno de los errores de documentacion mas comunes en las solicitudes del Mercado de Tennessee. Como ejemplo practico: un trabajador de Tennessee despedido en junio de 2026 que recibe $275 por semana en desempleo por 20 semanas agregaria $5,500 a su ingreso proyectado para el resto de 2026. Este monto podria elevar el ingreso por encima del 100% FPL, calificando al trabajador para creditos fiscales de prima del ACA en lugar de dejarlo en la brecha de cobertura. El sistema del Mercado le pedira que proyecte el ingreso total del hogar para 2026; si esa proyeccion resulta materialmente incorrecta, la reconcilia al momento de impuestos usando el Formulario 1095-A.

en.question: What is the SEP window after losing a job in Tennessee in 2026?
en.answer: Your loss-of-coverage Special Enrollment Period in Tennessee starts the day after your employer health coverage ends and runs for 60 consecutive days. For example, if coverage ends June 30, 2026, your SEP window is July 1 through August 29, 2026. Tennessee uses the federal Marketplace at healthcare.gov (not a state exchange), so you apply directly there. Plans typically take effect on the first of the month following enrollment. Medicaid (TennCare) has no 60-day deadline, but Tennessee's TennCare covers very few laid-off adults due to the state's non-expansion status.

en.question: Does TennCare cover me if I lose my job in Tennessee?
en.answer: Almost certainly not, unless you are pregnant, have dependent children and meet strict income rules, or qualify through a disability. Tennessee did not expand Medicaid under the ACA. TennCare eligibility for adults is limited to pregnant women, parents or caretaker relatives of minors with income typically below 95% FPL, people who are aged or blind, and individuals with qualifying disabilities. Most laid-off Tennessee workers must use the ACA Marketplace at healthcare.gov. Apply at tennessee.gov/tenncare or call 1-800-342-3145 to confirm your eligibility before ruling it out, but plan primarily for a Marketplace SEP application.

en.question: Is COBRA worth it after losing a job in Tennessee in 2026?
en.answer: Rarely. COBRA charges 102% of the full group premium, so you pay both the employer and employee share plus a 2% administrative fee. For a Tennessee single person, that is typically $500 to $900 per month in 2026. For a Tennessee family, it often reaches $1,200 to $2,800 per month. ACA Marketplace plans with income-based premium tax credits at healthcare.gov typically cost $10 to $300 per month for moderate-income Tennessee applicants, per the KFF 2026 Marketplace Premium Analysis. COBRA makes sense mainly when you have ongoing treatment with a Tennessee specialist not available in any Marketplace network, or when your 2026 deductible is already largely met.

en.question: What documents do I need to prove job loss for the Tennessee SEP application?
en.answer: Healthcare.gov accepts your Tennessee employer termination letter, a COBRA election notice, or a HIPAA certificate of creditable coverage as documentation of the qualifying life event. The document must show the date your employer coverage ends. Upload the documentation when you start your SEP application at healthcare.gov. If you do not have the document yet, begin the application and upload it later, but the 60-day SEP clock continues running. Contact your former Tennessee employer's HR department immediately to request the termination letter and HIPAA certificate of creditable coverage in writing.

en.question: What if my Tennessee income falls below 100% FPL and I do not qualify for TennCare?
en.answer: Tennessee's non-expansion status creates a coverage gap for adults with income below 100% FPL who do not meet TennCare categorical requirements. ACA premium tax credits start at 100% FPL, so people below that threshold generally cannot receive subsidized Marketplace coverage. Options in this gap include: Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs) that provide primary care on a sliding-fee scale; short-term health plans (not ACA-compliant, no pre-existing condition coverage); checking whether any household member's income lifts the household above 100% FPL; and contacting Tennessee Legal Aid (1-844-562-4243) to determine if any TennCare categorical pathway applies to your situation.

en.question: Does Tennessee unemployment compensation count toward ACA subsidy eligibility?
en.answer: Yes. Tennessee unemployment compensation counts as income for ACA Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) calculations. Include your weekly Tennessee unemployment benefit multiplied by the expected number of weeks of receipt in your projected 2026 annual income when applying for premium tax credits at healthcare.gov. Tennessee's maximum weekly unemployment benefit is $275 per week, with up to 26 weeks of eligibility. Accurately projecting this income matters: it may push you above 100% FPL, making you eligible for ACA subsidies, and it reduces the chance of owing back advance premium tax credits when you file your 2026 federal return using Form 1095-A.

en.question: What happens to my children's coverage after I lose my job in Tennessee?
en.answer: Tennessee's CoverKids program (CHIP) provides low-cost coverage for children up to age 19 in families with incomes up to approximately 250% FPL, well above adult TennCare thresholds. CoverKids enrollment is year-round with no 60-day deadline. Even if you do not qualify for TennCare after the job loss, your children may qualify for CoverKids at low or no cost. Apply at tennessee.gov/tenncare or through healthcare.gov. Children can also be enrolled in your new ACA Marketplace plan during the 60-day loss-of-coverage SEP. CHIP / CoverKids is almost always less expensive than adding children to COBRA continuation coverage.

en.question: What state-specific rules apply to job loss health insurance in Tennessee in 2026?
en.answer: Tennessee uses healthcare.gov for Marketplace enrollment (no separate state exchange). Tennessee did not expand Medicaid, so TennCare covers only narrow categories of adults. The TennCare brand name is used for Tennessee Medicaid; CoverKids is the CHIP program. Tennessee's maximum COBRA continuation under federal law applies to employers with 20 or more employees. Smaller Tennessee employers are not required to offer federal COBRA, though they may offer voluntary continuation. Tennessee does not have a state mini-COBRA law that universally extends continuation coverage for smaller employer plans. Check your Tennessee employer's plan documents for continuation options if your employer has fewer than 20 workers.

es.question: Cual es la ventana del SEP despues de perder un trabajo en Tennessee en 2026?
es.answer: Su Periodo de Inscripcion Especial por perdida de cobertura en Tennessee comienza el dia despues de que termina su cobertura medica del empleador y dura 60 dias consecutivos. Por ejemplo, si la cobertura termina el 30 de junio de 2026, su ventana SEP es del 1 de julio al 29 de agosto de 2026. Tennessee usa el Mercado federal en healthcare.gov (no un intercambio estatal), por lo que solicita directamente alli. Los planes tipicamente entran en vigor el primero del mes siguiente a su inscripcion. TennCare no tiene fecha limite de 60 dias, pero Tennessee no expandio Medicaid y TennCare cubre muy pocos adultos despedidos.

es.question: TennCare me cubre si pierdo mi trabajo en Tennessee?
es.answer: Casi con certeza no, a menos que este embarazada, tenga hijos dependientes y cumpla reglas estrictas de ingresos, o califique por discapacidad. Tennessee no expandio Medicaid bajo el ACA. La elegibilidad de TennCare para adultos se limita a mujeres embarazadas, padres o cuidadores de menores con ingresos tipicamente bajo el 95% FPL, personas mayores o ciegas, e individuos con discapacidades calificadas. La mayoria de trabajadores de Tennessee despedidos deben usar el Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov. Solicite en tennessee.gov/tenncare o llame al 1-800-342-3145 para confirmar su elegibilidad, pero planifique principalmente para una solicitud SEP del Mercado.

es.question: Vale la pena COBRA despues de perder un trabajo en Tennessee en 2026?
es.answer: Raramente. COBRA cobra el 102% de la prima grupal completa, por lo que paga tanto la parte del empleador como la del empleado mas el 2% de tarifa administrativa. Para una persona en Tennessee, eso es tipicamente $500 a $900 al mes en 2026. Para una familia de Tennessee, a menudo llega a $1,200 a $2,800 al mes. Los planes del Mercado ACA con creditos fiscales de prima basados en ingresos en healthcare.gov tipicamente cuestan $10 a $300 al mes para solicitantes de ingresos moderados de Tennessee, segun el Analisis de Prima del Mercado KFF 2026. COBRA tiene sentido principalmente cuando tiene tratamiento continuo con un especialista de Tennessee no disponible en ninguna red del Mercado, o cuando su deducible de 2026 ya esta en gran parte cumplido.

es.question: Que documentos necesito para probar la perdida del trabajo para la solicitud SEP de Tennessee?
es.answer: Healthcare.gov acepta su carta de terminacion del empleador de Tennessee, un aviso de eleccion COBRA o un certificado de cobertura acreditable de HIPAA como documentacion del evento calificador de vida. El documento debe mostrar la fecha en que termina su cobertura del empleador. Cargue la documentacion cuando comience su solicitud SEP en healthcare.gov. Si aun no tiene el documento, comience la solicitud y carguela despues, pero el reloj SEP de 60 dias sigue corriendo. Contacte inmediatamente al departamento de recursos humanos de su antiguo empleador en Tennessee para solicitar la carta de terminacion y el certificado HIPAA por escrito.

es.question: Que pasa si mis ingresos en Tennessee caen por debajo del 100% FPL y no califico para TennCare?
es.answer: El estado de no expansion de Tennessee crea una brecha de cobertura para adultos con ingresos por debajo del 100% FPL que no cumplen los requisitos categoricos de TennCare. Los creditos fiscales de prima del ACA comienzan al 100% FPL, por lo que las personas por debajo de ese umbral generalmente no pueden recibir cobertura subsidiada del Mercado. Las opciones en esta brecha incluyen: Centros de Salud Federalmente Calificados (FQHCs) que brindan atencion primaria con tarifas escalonadas; planes de salud a corto plazo (no cumplen ACA, sin cobertura de condiciones preexistentes); verificar si el ingreso de algun miembro del hogar eleva el hogar por encima del 100% FPL; y contactar a Tennessee Legal Aid (1-844-562-4243) para determinar si algun camino categorico de TennCare aplica.

es.question: Cuenta la compensacion por desempleo de Tennessee para la elegibilidad de subsidio ACA?
es.answer: Si. La compensacion por desempleo de Tennessee cuenta como ingreso para los calculos del Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) del ACA. Incluya su beneficio semanal de desempleo de Tennessee multiplicado por el numero esperado de semanas de recibo en su ingreso anual proyectado de 2026 al solicitar creditos fiscales de prima en healthcare.gov. El beneficio semanal maximo de desempleo de Tennessee es $275 por semana, con hasta 26 semanas de elegibilidad. Proyectar este ingreso con precision importa: puede elevarlo por encima del 100% FPL, haciendolo elegible para subsidios ACA, y reduce la posibilidad de deber creditos fiscales de prima anticipados al presentar su declaracion federal de 2026 usando el Formulario 1095-A.

es.question: Que pasa con la cobertura de mis hijos despues de perder mi trabajo en Tennessee?
es.answer: El programa CoverKids de Tennessee (CHIP) proporciona cobertura de bajo costo para ninos hasta 19 anos en familias con ingresos hasta aproximadamente 250% FPL, muy por encima de los umbrales de TennCare para adultos. La inscripcion en CoverKids es todo el ano sin fecha limite de 60 dias. Incluso si usted no califica para TennCare despues de perder el trabajo, sus hijos pueden calificar para CoverKids a bajo costo o sin costo. Solicite en tennessee.gov/tenncare o a traves de healthcare.gov. Los ninos tambien pueden inscribirse en su nuevo plan del Mercado ACA durante el SEP de 60 dias. CHIP / CoverKids es casi siempre menos costoso que agregar ninos a la cobertura de continuacion COBRA.

es.question: Que reglas especificas de Tennessee aplican al seguro medico por perdida de trabajo en 2026?
es.answer: Tennessee usa healthcare.gov para la inscripcion en el Mercado (no un intercambio estatal separado). Tennessee no expandio Medicaid, por lo que TennCare cubre solo categorias limitadas de adultos. El nombre de marca TennCare se usa para el Medicaid de Tennessee; CoverKids es el programa CHIP. La continuacion maxima de COBRA bajo la ley federal aplica a empleadores con 20 o mas empleados. Los empleadores mas pequenos de Tennessee no estan obligados a ofrecer COBRA federal, aunque pueden ofrecer continuacion voluntaria. Tennessee no tiene una ley estatal mini-COBRA que extienda universalmente la cobertura de continuacion para planes de empleadores mas pequenos.
